newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat trades steady, seen heading down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat trades steady, seen heading down.

text.p: Wheat futures traded steady on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Friday with 23 lots of the January contract changing hands.
The contract sold at A$187.00 and A$188.00 a tonne, with the A$188.00 last sale steady with Thursday's close. No other contracts traded on Friday.
Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said there was good grower selling at A$188.00 and sporadic end-user and speculative buying. "It is fairly firm at this level."
But chartists said the market had broken A$190.00 for January futures and was looking to a drop to A$178.00, he said.
